user.title: Log in to myUplink
user.description: Høiax Connected water heaters are controlled through myUplink. Use the same e-mail and password as in the myUplink app ({myuplink_url}). The water heater must already be added to your myUplink account.

data_description.username: The e-mail address you use to log in to the myUplink app.
data_description.password: Your myUplink password. It is stored locally in Home Assistant and only sent to myUplink.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in to myUplink again
reauth_confirm.description: myUplink no longer accepts the stored password for {username}. Enter your current password.

reconfigure.title: Change myUplink login
reconfigure.description: Update the e-mail or password used for this account.

error.invalid_auth: Wrong e-mail or password. Check that you can log in to the myUplink app with the same details.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach myUplink. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.no_devices: Login worked, but no devices were found on this myUplink account. Add the water heater in the myUplink app first.
error.unknown: Unexpected error, see the log for details.

abort.already_configured: This myUplink account is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: You must use the same myUplink account. To use another account, add the integration again.

data_description.scan_interval: How often (in seconds) values are fetched from myUplink.

auth_failed.message: myUplink rejected the login. Log in again under Settings → Devices & services.

write_failed.message: Could not send the change to the water heater: {error}
